intent.job_to_be_done: Complete, resume, or verify production-safe GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and Google Search Console onboarding for any website, including intent-aware sitemap submission and bounded Search Analytics readback, while keeping setup, transport, provider, search-performance, crawling, and indexing evidence separate.
target_users: Nemo operator launching game, SaaS, content, documentation, or other websites
inputs: canonical production origin and preview origins
requested GA4, Clarity, and/or GSC components
authenticated provider contexts when external setup is authorized
authoritative DNS and sitemap context when GSC is requested
optional exact Google Cloud/quota project and existing ADC context when google_api mode is selected
outputs: read-only first-use readiness check with local, site, identity, login, permission, and blocker states
user-visible Google API bootstrap and per-component configuration plan with exact identity, capabilities, desired resources, existing matches, external writes, readback, and rollback
GA4 setup, production request, Realtime, and DebugView states
Clarity setup, tag, collect request, and recording states
GSC property, DNS, ownership, sitemap operation/action, provider status, and indexing states
bounded read-only GSC Search Analytics rows with exact query identity and completeness caveats
optional credential-free Google API capability, plan/apply/readback, and evidence-source states
exclusions: routine analytics reporting and session analysis
SEO ranking, keyword, and content opportunity analysis

release_gates.optional_gcloud_requirement: ADC short-lived token and explicit API bootstrap only
release_gates.provider_or_human_output_evidence: provider-backed for the bounded GSC Search Analytics read primitive verified on 2026-08-20; GA4, Clarity, sitemap mutation, bootstrap writes, complete cross-provider onboarding, and blind human review remain missing evidence
